name: Bundle
description: Prey that got up again: a body wrapped for the larder, still walking, with three courses of silk over an abdomen half again too big for the legs under it and one split where something inside pushed through. The cave's version of the thing that is simply in the way — and in a cave the way is the hole you tore in the silk, which a body this wide corks. Wears silk rather than using it. Gameplay radius 13.

elite.description: Marked: the wrapping bleaches to bone and the split goes bright — a larder at five times the size.

heave.description: a slow four-beat under a load: the wrapped abdomen lags the body and keeps swinging after it has stopped, which is the whole read — the silk is carrying more than the legs are
